name: ctm-flag
description: Lightweight call annotation tool that injects into Call Tracking Metrics (CTM) and lets your team flag calls with shared, real-time notes.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f ctm-flag-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../ctm-flag-extension.zip . && cd .. && echo "\nPackaged → ctm-flag-extension.zip  (share this file with teammates)"
